{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "MMMM d, yyyy") }}
To the Pastor and Congregation:

Greetings in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

This letter is to certify that {{ doc.full_name }} {% set _mem = (doc.life_events or []) | selectattr("event_type", "equalto", "Membership") | sort(attribute="date") | first %}{% if _mem %}was received into membership of our church on {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(_mem.date, "MMMM d, yyyy") }}{% endif %} and has been an active member in good standing.

{% set baptism = (doc.life_events or []) | selectattr("event_type", "equalto", "Baptism") | first %} {% if baptism %} They were baptized on {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(baptism.date, "MMMM d, yyyy") }}. {% endif %}

We commend them to your fellowship and care, and pray that the Lord may bless your ministry together. Please receive them with the love of Christ.

If you have any questions regarding this transfer, please do not hesitate to contact our office.

In Christ,
__________________________
Pastor
